tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: Read actual completed Kraken OHLC market observations, timestamped and linked to their public source. No forecast or trade.

tools.name: analyze_perps
tools.description: Read actual Hyperliquid perpetual funding and open-interest snapshots from existing SignalForge adapters.

tools.name: research_prediction_market
tools.description: Inspect public Polymarket event-market observations, probabilities are source-reported only.

tools.name: inspect_solana_token
tools.description: Inspect DEX Screener reported Solana mint liquidity; requires a valid Solana base58 address.

tools.name: create_research_task
tools.description: Submit user-owned, read-only market research WorkPacket to existing durable SignalForge queue. Requires personal paid SignalForge API key.

tools.name: get_task_result
tools.description: Read your queued/finished research, source artifact and bounded task events. Owner scope enforced.

tools.name: verify_research_receipt
tools.description: Independently recompute SourceA-compatible artifact hash and source timestamp contract for your completed task. SHA-256 is not a provider signature.

tools.name: cancel_research_task
tools.description: Cancel only your own queued or running read-only customer research task. No payment or trade effects.
